gaps.evidence: web/src/pages/RunDetailPage.tsx:268-291 and :353-382; DOM run-detail has Revise twice, Audit twice, Download twice
gaps.impact: Duplicate actions with identical effect; no unique capability lost, but two controls per action increase misclick/ambiguity and Forge must verify both stay in sync.

gaps.evidence: web/src/pages/AgentsPage.tsx:155,381-385; 37 cards rendered; first card GET /api/agents/router 200; no schema-valid badge in visible card DOM
gaps.impact: Agent capability/evidence surface: cards expose UNVERIFIED/REGISTERED, but the promised schema-valid evidence is not visible on the cards. Forge should trace evidence badge rendering, not assume all 37.

gaps.evidence: web/src/pages/LearningPage.tsx:164-167; GET /api/learning/overview 200 E_LEARNING_POOL_EXHAUSTED; promotion buttons at :501/:512 not rendered
gaps.impact: Correct refusal, not a dead control; the approval/promotion chain is unreachable in this build and cannot be exercised by the auditor.

gaps.evidence: web/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx:47-56; DOM says Configured Yes, Checked Not reported, Balance Not reported
gaps.impact: No false zero or key leak, but key capability/balance is not surfaced; capability claim stops at configured/fingerprint.

gaps.evidence: web/src/pages/AgentsPage.tsx:479; Run agent disabled with empty input; only generic schema text at :477
gaps.impact: Disabled state lacks a specific inline reason for this agent; Forge should trace whether the disabled condition is explained by required Input.

gaps.evidence: web/src/pages/RunDetailPage.tsx:272,289,353; Stop absent on terminal run; Download/Open folder present but not exercised
gaps.impact: Negative paths for Stop/Download/Open folder remain UNVERIFIED; Forge must trace errors/cancel without creating a new run.

gaps.evidence: web/src/pages/VaultPage.tsx:92; 84 tree buttons rendered; only one file clicked (GET 200); directory toggles and 83 file previews not exercised
gaps.impact: Vault file/tree chain is sample-verified only; Forge should deep-trace tree path encoding, empty/error, and path traversal guards.

gaps.evidence: web/src/pages/RunsPage.tsx:48; safe Completed filter reduced rendered run rows 15->12 with no API call
gaps.impact: Filter is wired client-side; count/empty-filter state was not independently asserted by server; Forge should trace all statuses and empty state.
